plain_statement: It is false that: The edge function F of the Petersen graph minus a vertex (9 inputs, 12 edges). Call a circuit of AND, OR and NOT gates REDUCED if it is a least circuit for F with at most 15 gates, every gate reads earlier wires (a NOT one, the others two different ones), and each of the degree-two inputs x_4, x_6, x_7 is read by one gate, or by two gates that are both OR gates. No reduced circuit has every reader of x_4, x_6 and x_7 an OR gate and one of those inputs read by two gates.
